text:
Alex (CEO): Thanks for the great all-hands. Quick live thread for any short follow-ups on strategy/market/roadmap. Keep replies concise.
Jordan (Growth): Need a battlecard sentence for sales vs hyperscalers that isn't negative.
Alex (CEO): Try: "Redwood makes inference predictable and cost-effective across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."
Maya (Head of Product): Add a 2nd line for demos: "Shows token-level cost, automatic fallbacks, and seamless model pinning."
Sam (VP Eng): Tech Q: customers ask if moving to Dedicated changes API surface. Answer?
Ravi (CTO): No API change. Same endpoints, same SDKs. Dedicated just adds reserved capacity, SLAs, and private networking.
Priya (Solutions): Can we promise low-friction migration from Hosted -> Dedicated? Need exact wording.
Maya (Head of Product): Say: "Prototype on Hosted, lift-and-shift to Dedicated with config export & SE support."
Jordan (Growth): Competitor nuance: how blunt about cost comparisons?
Alex (CEO): Be factual: use anonymized case studies and percent cost delta when possible. Avoid absolute guarantees without workload context.
Sam (VP Eng): Roadmap: any feature we should call out in next customer newsletter?
Maya (Head of Product): Call out: SLA FAQ, console token-cost drilldown, and model-variant routing beta (4-6 weeks).
Ravi (CTO): Also mention upcoming KV-cache improvements for long-context workloads.
Priya (Solutions): Sales ask: sample 15s pitch for security-conscious customers?
Jordan (Growth): "Redwood offers a private deployment option with customer-managed VPC, KMS integration, and audit logs, so you keep control."
Alex (CEO): Great. One more: which metric should teams track next quarter?
Maya (Head of Product): TTFSQ (time-to-first-successful-query) and cost per 1M tokens. Short and measurable.
allhands-bot: Reminder: post-all-hands survey link in #announcements — please complete. :wave:
Alex (CEO): Thanks all. If anything missed, tag the relevant person and we'll follow up in channel.
